title: SmartJoin
description: Smart join manage your join messade and leave message
body:
# **🌟 SmartJoin – is a simple and easy plugin for custom join/leave messages!**

SmartJoin is a easy plugin that allows you to customize how players are welcomed to or leave your server. Get rid of the boring "Player joined the game" and "Player left the game", and replace them with something that suits your server's style.

# **🔧 Features:**
- Customize both join and leave messages
- Support for color codes (e.g. &a, &c, &l for bold)
- Works for both players and administrators
- Minimal performance impact
  
<details>
<summary>Config.yml</summary>


```
#For you to get player name use [playerName]
#Here can you choose what the join message should be.
join-messages:
  - "&a+ [playerName] joined the party!"
  - "&a+ &eSay hello to [playerName]!"
  - "&a+ &6Welcome, [playerName], to our server!"

#Here can you choose what the quit message should be.
quit-messages:
  - "&4- &c[playerName] left the game."
  - "&4- &7Goodbye, [playerName]!"
  - "&4- &c[playerName] has logged off."
```
Available placeholders:

[playerName] – automatically replaced with the player's name


</details>

# **🎯 Why choose SmartJoin?**

SmartJoin is perfect for those who want to create a more personal and professional feel on their server – without burdening resources or adding hassle. Install, configure and run – it's that easy!
